about: Sentiment for shareholders, from the headline alone: 165 BSE announcements 2024-01..2026-06, 11 per event type (hash-ordered, seed 'sent-2026'). Labelled by Claude, not the owner, with one rule: negative only when the text states an adverse fact (auditor resignation, tax demand/penalty/payment notice, CFO resignation); positive only when it states a favourable one (orders/contracts won, alliance, operations started, dividend recommended); everything without a stated direction is neutral - including results without numbers and fund raising (dilution cuts both ways). Overrule by editing gold.
